description: Camera Ninja road matching keeps every highway=* way in the DB. This file only marks whether an edge is a plausible motor-vehicle road for default matching.
notes: service, residential, living_street, unclassified, road and track are retained as plausible motor-vehicle roads unless an explicit motor_vehicle/motorcar=no overrides them.
access=private is not treated as physically non-drivable because Camera Ninja performs observation/map matching rather than legal route guidance.
All excluded/non-drivable highway ways are still stored in the road database with drivable=0 for diagnostics and future policy changes.
